translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content.text: Me sunsum atɔ piti,
me nna so atwa,
na damena retwɛn me.
Ampa ara fɛdifoɔ atwa me ho ahyia;
ɛsɛ sɛ mehwɛ wɔn atutupɛ.
“Ao Onyankopɔn, hyɛ me ɛbɔ a wopɛ.
Hwan bio na ɔbɛma me banbɔ?
Woato wɔn adwene mu a wɔnte asɛm ase;
enti woremma wɔnni nkonim.
Sɛ obi sopa ne nnamfonom de nya akatua a,
ne mma ani bɛfira.
“Onyankopɔn de me ayɛ asɛm a ɛda obiara ano,
obi a wɔte ntasuo gu nʼani so.
Awerɛhoɔ ama mʼani ayɛ samoo
me bɔberɛ nyinaa yɛ sunsumma.
Ateneneefoɔ hunu me a, ɛyɛ wɔn nwanwa.
Wɔn a wɔdi bem no bɛsɔre atia wɔn a wɔnni nyamesu.
Ateneneefoɔ bɛkɔ wɔn anim,
na wɔn a wɔn nsa ho teɛ bɛkɔ so anya ahoɔden.
“Mo nyinaa mo nsane mmra mmɛsɔ me nhwɛ!
Na merennya onyansafoɔ wɔ mo mu.
Me nna atwam, me nhyehyɛeɛ apansam,
saa ara na mʼakoma apɛdeɛ nso ayɛ.
Saa nnipa yi ma anadwo dane awia;
esum mu koraa no, wɔka sɛ, ‘Hann abɛn,’
Sɛ efie baako pɛ a mʼani da so ne damena,
sɛ mesɛ me kɛtɛ wɔ esum mu,
sɛ meka kyerɛ porɔeɛ sɛ, ‘Woyɛ mʼagya,’
na me kyerɛ ɔsonsono sɛ, ‘Me maame’ anaa ‘Me nuabaa’ a,
na afei mʼanidasoɔ wɔ he?
Hwan na ɔbɛtumi anya anidasoɔ bi ama me?
Ɛbɛsiane akɔ owuo ɛpono ano anaa?
Yɛn nyinaa bɛsiane akɔ mfuturo mu anaa?”
